text: Heather painted an incredible view from one of our favorite hikes in the North Cascades and captured its beauty perfectly! I am so impressed by her painting skills, ease of working with, and overall experience. She has a really cool and interesting painting style, and we always get compliments on our piece. She is a people person, and she guided us through all of the questions to learn about our goals, bringing our vision to life. From start to finish, the experience was a 10/10, and we love our keepsake painting. She even shipped it across the country, packaging it carefully to ensure it could make the journey safely. I whole heartedly recommend Heather Wolfe Art to capture your special events and places.

I hope every time you look at your painting you can remember that special feeling from your beautiful hike! Thank you again for all your support!💗
